parkReason: Wayfire layout state and command proofs passed within the Den 4251 churn budget; Smithay implementation should not start until a stop/go condition changes.

primarySources.name: Smithay README
primarySources.finding: Smithay provides building blocks for Wayland compositors rather than a full compositor framework.

primarySources.name: Smithay docs.rs
primarySources.finding: Smithay handles low-level compositor/protocol interactions; window management and drawing logic remain compositor-owned.

primarySources.name: Smithay GETTING_STARTED
primarySources.finding: smallvil is the smallest usable learning compositor; anvil is the fuller Smithay testing compositor.

primarySources.name: Smithay Anvil README
primarySources.finding: Anvil is a testing ground for Smithay features; smallvil is the simpler starting point.

startOnlyIf: Wayfire layout authority proof requires synthetic keyboard shortcuts
Wayfire layout authority proof infers geometry from shell state or screenshots
Wayfire plugin depends on unexported simple-tile internals
Wayfire plugin grows into shell UI, launcher, governance, or theme policy
Wayfire path exceeds the Den 4251 churn budget
currentEvidence: Den 4270 Rust layout-model command semantics are checked

minimalDeliverables.description: Start a Smithay compositor on den-k8 and host at least two real xdg-shell native client surfaces.
Apply the Rust layout-model command semantics to tiled primary/secondary zones with backend-owned geometry.
Report focus order, surface order, unmap cleanup, and stale/missing classifications through the generated layout contract.
Produce capture-visible evidence that the two native clients are non-overlapping and annotated or otherwise agent-identifiable.

den4251Criteria.smithayProofAction: Own xdg-shell placement in the compositor state and emit geometry directly after configure/commit.
Implement assign-zone or tile plus move-resize against the Rust layout-model command fixture.
Maintain explicit workspace surface_order and focus_order in compositor state.
Remove or mark unmapped surfaces and return surface_stale or surface_not_found as defined by layout-model.
Provide a minimal compositor-owned overlay or deterministic bounds evidence visible in output capture.

live: launch Smithay spike in a non-default nested backend first
launch Alacritty and foot against the spike Wayland socket
run a layout command fixture equivalent against the spike control path
capture den-k8 output and prove non-overlap

go: Wayfire hits any implementationTrigger startOnlyIf condition
Smithay hosts two native clients and passes the layout command fixture with less code/churn than the Wayfire path
stop: cannot host real native clients on den-k8
